race.comment: BRING ME CHOCOLATE (13) justified the good support on debut when she finished over the top of them for a decisive victory as fav over 1000m at Muswellbrook. Looks to have the upside to progress further in this stronger contest. STILL ALICE (3) capable on her day and the two runs back have been encouraging. Sat on the fast tempo to finish a narrow third over 1000m at Kembla Grange. Tricky map today but expected to be thereabouts. DIFENSIVO (7) trained locally and assess on the good win over 1000m two-back at Gosford on the heavy surface. Place best from the gate. CELESTIAL DEAL (15) worked hard early from the outside gate with a plugging fourth over 1200m at Scone. Gets a better set-up for this and stays in the calculations. FLEET FLYER (11) undefeated in two starts at this track and will need a fair bit of luck today from a wide gate.
